name: Devanahalli-Boodihal
tagline: A township setting with a multigenerational home choice.
description: This guide covers the Boodihal–Brigade Orchards side of the Devanahalli search area. Brigade Orchards is a township setting with Signature Club Resort as a recognisable landmark. Laurel & Maple brings different apartment formats and a Primus-operated service proposition within a distinct enclave of the larger development.
